summary: Validated frontend-only fix for accumulating multiple JSON files in the 'Migración BD' import modal on /quotes. Logged in as admin rgonzalez@megasoft.com.ve, opened the bundle migration modal, switched to the 'Importar' tab, and exercised the new dataFiles state via the bundle-import-data-file-input. All four scenarios passed: (1) first file appears in the list, (2) selecting a second file ACCUMULATES (not replaces) — list shows '2 archivo(s) en cola' with items item-0 and item-1, (3) removing a single item drops the count to 1 and re-keys the list, (4) 'Limpiar todo' empties the list, hides the panel, and disables the 'Aplicar' button.

first_file_upload.expected: List visible with 1 item (item-0) and counter '1 archivo(s) en cola'
first_file_upload.observed: List visible=true, items=1, counter='1 archivo(s) en cola'

accumulation_on_second_upload.expected: Second set_input_files call adds page_2.json without removing page_1.json. List shows '2 archivo(s) en cola' with items item-0 and item-1.
accumulation_on_second_upload.observed: items=2, item-1 exists, list text contains '2 archivo(s) en cola' and both 'page_1.json' and 'page_2.json'.

apply_button_counter_and_state.expected: Aplicar shows '(2)' and is enabled when there are 2 files

remove_individual_file.expected: Clicking bundle-import-data-file-remove-0 reduces list to 1 item
remove_individual_file.observed: items=1 after remove, remaining item shows 'page_2.json' (item-0 re-keyed), counter='1 archivo(s) en cola'

clear_all.expected: 'Limpiar todo' empties the queue, hides the file list panel, and disables Aplicar
clear_all.observed: list visible=False, items=0, Apply text='Aplicar' (no counter), disabled=True

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warnings: <span> cannot be child of <tbody>/<tr> (already reported in iteration_113). Not related to this fix; consider cleaning up the data-ve-dynamic <span style='display:contents'> wrappers around <tr>.
Radix Dialog warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent. Cosmetic a11y warning, not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: QuotesBundleMigrationModal.jsx handleDataFilesChange correctly: (a) accumulates via setDataFiles(prev => [...]), (b) dedupes by `${name}:${size}`, (c) resets e.target.value='' so the same input can re-accept the same file. Behavior matches the requirement.

removeDataFile uses index-based filter; the keys in the rendered list use `${f.name}:${f.size}:${i}` so React reconciliation is stable across removals. Confirmed in DOM (item-0 re-keys to the remaining file after removal).
Minor (out of scope): handleImportData reads `dataFiles` directly (good). No regression observed; not exercised in this test per instructions.
seed_data_creation: Created two temp JSON files /tmp/bundle_test/page_1.json and /tmp/bundle_test/page_2.json with minimal valid JSON ({"quotes":[]}, {"quotes":[],"page":2}). Used set_input_files in two separate calls to simulate independent user selections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Accumulating-files fix in QuotesBundleMigrationModal.jsx is fully validated in preview. No backend interaction was exercised (Aplicar not clicked per instructions). The only outstanding non-blocking items are pre-existing hydration warnings in QuotesTable/Dashboard (already documented in iteration_113) and a Radix DialogContent a11y warning. Both unrelated to this iteration's fix.
rca of the issue: Original bug: <input type=file multiple> resets its FileList on every open, so picking files in two separate dialog interactions kept only the latest selection. Fix: introduce a React-controlled cumulative array `dataFiles`; on change, merge picked files into state (deduped by name+size), reset the input's value to '' so the same name can be re-added, and render a removable list. handleImportData now iterates over dataFiles[]. Verified live: items accumulate across separate selections, can be individually removed, and cleared as a group; Aplicar counter reflects the queue length and disabled state mirrors dataFiles.length === 0.
